_comment: Tissue media per organ: which Human Protein Atlas normal tissue and which HRA 2D tissue unit organ (Uberon id) belong to which of our organ nodes (concept ids: male BodyParts3D concepts, or the root concept of an organ shown on its own). Media attach to these nodes; is_a descendants inherit them (left kidney gets the kidney's). Read by pipeline/08-histology.py. `tables`: ASCT+B tables whose cell types belong on these organs' tissue boards; a cell type is placed in the deepest structure of its row when that structure lies inside the organ, else in the organ itself. `hpa` is the HPA IHC tissue the image must show; `hpaRna` (when different) is HPA's consensus RNA tissue used to find enriched genes (e.g. the spleen is under 'lymphoid tissue').

missingImages._note: Images that HPA's own records name but its image server answers 404 Not Found for (checked on the date given). Step 08 treats a candidate whose representative image is listed here as having none for that tissue, the case its rule already covers; step 10 treats a listed full-resolution file as absent. Any other failed download, and a 404 for an image not listed here, stops the step (pipeline/_http.py). Remove an entry to try that image again.
